name: Live Routes
description: Real-time request routing dashboard for CLIProxyAPI: watch requests flow from clients through API keys to upstream models, with in-flight state, retries, token usage and session/sub-agent links. Memory only, nothing written to disk. | CLIProxyAPI 实时请求路由看板：实时查看请求从客户端、API Key 到上游模型的流向，含进行中状态、重试、Token 用量与会话/子代理关系。仅占用内存，不写入磁盘。
